title: Identify users who obtained a 'Student' badge in 2010 or 2011 and also own
question: Identify users who obtained a 'Student' badge in 2010 or 2011 and also own at least one post created in 2010. Among these users, return the display names of those whose reputation is less than or equal to the average reputation of all users who have ever received any badge.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM users u
WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT b.XCL_002
    FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Student'
      AND (strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2010' OR strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2011')
)
AND u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT p.XCL_033
    FROM posts p
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
)
AND u.XCL_053 <= (
    SELECT AVG(u2.XCL_053)
    FROM users u2
    WHERE u2.XCL_052 IN (SELECT DISTINCT XCL_002 FROM badges)
)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH student_badge_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
    WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Student'
      AND (strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004)='2010' OR strftime('%Y', b.XCL_004)='2011')
),
post_2010_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029)='2010'
),
qualified_users AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_052
    FROM student_badge_users s
    INNER JOIN post_2010_users p ON s.XCL_052 = p.XCL_052
),
avg_reputation AS (
    SELECT AVG(u.XCL_053) AS avg_rep
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
)
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM users u
INNER JOIN qualified_users q ON u.XCL_052 = q.XCL_052
CROSS JOIN avg_reputation ar
WHERE u.XCL_053 <= ar.avg_rep
